Class Triangle

java.lang.Object
AbstractShape
Triangle
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Shape>, Shape
public class Triangle extends AbstractShape
This class represents a triangle. It offers all the operations mandated by the Shape interface.

  • Constructor Details

    • Triangle

      public Triangle(double xRef, double yRef, double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2)
      Construct a Triangle with 3 unique vertices
      Parameters:
      xRef - x-coordinate of the reference vertex
      yRef - y-coordinate of the reference vertex
      x1 - x-coordinate of the 1st vertex other than the reference
      y1 - y-coordinate of the 1st vertex other than the reference
      x2 - x-coordinate of the 2nd vertex other than the reference
      y2 - y-coordinate of the 2nd vertex other than the reference
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if vertices are not unique (2 or 3 vertices that are the same)

  • Method Details

    • area

      public double area()
      Calculate the area of a triangle using Heron's Formula using only the three sides: Math.sqrt(s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c)) If a triangle is invalid (its vertices are collinear), return 0
      Returns:
      the area of a valid triangle

    • perimeter

      public double perimeter()
      Calculate the perimeter of a triangle. If the triangle is degenerate, meaning its vertices are collinear, then return 0.
      Returns:
      the perimeter of a triangle, 0 if the vertices are collinear.

    • resize

      public Shape resize(double factor)
      Resize the triangle by multiplying the area by the resizing factor, starting from the reference point
      Parameters:
      factor - factor of resizing
      Returns:
      a new Triangle object that is the resized version of the original Shape
